---
title: "Modules"
---

Modules are the primary teaching units. Keep each module focused on a coherent set of concepts or skills.

| Module | Topic | Main components |
|---:|---|---|
| 01 | [TOPIC_TITLE](01-topic/index.qmd) | notes · slides · lab · exercise |

## Standard module pattern

Each module contains:

- `module.yml` — order, duration, questions, and objectives;
- `index.qmd` — learner-facing lesson notes;
- `slides.qmd` — presentation slides;
- `lab.qmd` — guided practical work;
- `exercise.qmd` — formative practice;
- `instructor-notes.md` — timing, misconceptions, adaptations, and post-class notes.

Copy `01-topic/`, rename it with the next numeric prefix, and update the module metadata.
